audience: product managers and analysts who track user behavior in Mixpanel

useCases.title: See today's top events and what changed
useCases.text: The AI lists today's top events with counts and the change against yesterday. Use it to see what a project tracks and what moved.

useCases.title: Count an event by day or by property
useCases.text: The AI counts one event over a date range and splits it by a property such as country, with optional filters. You get sign-ups per day or per segment.

useCases.title: Check conversion in a saved funnel
useCases.text: The AI lists the saved funnels of the project and reads the conversion data of one. You see where users drop off.

useCases.title: Measure how many users come back
useCases.text: The AI runs a retention report: of users who did a first event, how many did a second event in later intervals. You see if new users return.

useCases.title: Read an Insights report or run a custom JQL query
useCases.text: The AI fetches the computed data behind a saved Insights report by its id and explains the numbers. For other questions it can run a custom JQL script.
